findings.issue: Spanish makes «todo lo que» the thing that falls onto a separate «él». יִפֹּל is qal imperfect 3ms with no subject pronoun; מֵהֶם is only the plural source, and the 3ms suffix on עָלָיו resumes כֹּל as what is fallen upon and what יִטְמָא makes unclean.
findings.spanishSpan: todo lo que cayere sobre él desde ellos

findings.issue: בְּמֹתָם is a singular noun with a 3mp suffix, their death, the same plural as מֵהֶם. «su» can be read as singular «él».
Qal is a stative be/become unclean; pronominal se impurecerá is inchoative smoothing and can sound reflexive, without a new actor or a causative stem.
Definite עֶרֶב is evening; la tarde in current Latin American Spanish often means afternoon, so the time limit is slightly uncertain.

notes: The article list, niphal work-in-them, hophal brought into the waters, and qal stative puro stay inside the tokens.
